41:     from win32_worker_connection import _absolute_local_path

85: class GeneratedLifecyclePort:
86:     """One connected dummy run; no model operation methods are implemented.
87: 
88:     Inputs must come from the future exact generated-only launcher. This class
89:     does not turn a manifest, object permit or message into runtime authority.
90:     It has no durable crash-recovery implementation and does not publish assets.
91:     """
92: 
93:     def __init__(self, primitives, pipes, expectations, executable, arguments,
94:                  working_directory, environment, generation_hex, manifest_sha256,
95:                  namespace_sha256, child_source_sha256, master_key, pipe_name_material, case):
96:         _assert(type(expectations) is tuple and len(expectations) == 5, "five_generated_files_only")
97:         _assert(tuple(path for path, identity in expectations) == fixed_paths(working_directory), "fixed_generated_paths")
98:         _assert(type(case) is str and case in ("positive", "wrong_identity"), "fixed_generated_case")
99:         _assert(namespace_sha256 == namespace_digest(), "fixed_generated_namespace")
100:         self.case = case
101:         self.expected_exit = 0 if case == "positive" else 2
102:         self.adoption_response = None
103:         self.adoption_payload = None
104:         self.primitives, self.pipes, self.expectations = primitives, pipes, expectations
105:         self.executable, self.arguments, self.cwd, self.environment = executable, arguments, working_directory, environment
106:         self.generation, self.manifest, self.namespace, self.source = generation_hex, manifest_sha256, namespace_sha256, child_source_sha256
107:         self.master_key, self.pipe_material = master_key, pipe_name_material
108:         self.lifecycle = SnapshotLifecycle(self)
109:         self.profile = object()
110:         self.key = self.read_set = self.worker = self.pair = self.channel = self.handshake = self.permit = None
111:         self.exit_observation = None
112:         self.observations = []
113:         self.parent_guards_held_through_exit = False
114:         self._start_attempted = self._resume_attempted = False
115: 
116:     def acquire_read(self, key):
117:         _assert(self.key is None and self.read_set is None, "single_generated_acquisition")
118:         self.key = key
119:         self.read_set = self.primitives.pin_exact_members(self.expectations)
120:         return self.read_set

122:     def _record(self, protection, permit):
123:         record = self.lifecycle._records.get(self.key)
124:         _assert(record is not None and record.protection is protection and record.permit is permit
125:                 and record.owner is not None and record.owner._manager is self.lifecycle,
126:                 "exact_lifecycle_record_and_permit_required")
127:         return record

129:     def start_owned_worker(self, protection, permit, profile):
130:         raise KernelUnavailable("Split durable startup is required")

132:     def create_suspended(self, protection, permit, profile):
133:         record = self._record(protection, permit)
134:         _assert(record.phase is Phase.NATIVE_RESERVED and profile is self.profile and self.worker is None,
135:                 "dummy_start_order_and_profile")
136:         self._start_attempted = True
137:         self.permit = permit
138:         self.pair = self.pipes.create_pair(self.pipe_material, _remaining(self.pipes.clock))
139:         self.pair.read_set = protection
140:         try:
141:             self.worker = self.pipes.attach_to_suspended_worker(self.pair, protection, self.executable,
142:                 self.arguments, self.cwd, self.environment)
143:             self.adoption_payload = controller_manifest(self.primitives, protection, self.worker, self.cwd, self.case)
144:             self.manifest = manifest_digest(self.adoption_payload)
145:             binding = GenerationBinding(self.generation, self.manifest, self.namespace, self.source, self.worker.creation_time)
146:             self.channel = GenerationChannel(binding, self.master_key, "controller")
147:             self.handshake = ControllerHandshake(self.channel, record.owner, permit, self.primitives, self.worker)
148:             return self.worker
149:         except BaseException:
150:             self.pipes._quarantine(self.pair)
151:             raise

153:     def resume(self, worker):
154:         record = self._record(self.read_set, self.permit)
155:         _assert(worker is self.worker and record.phase is Phase.NATIVE_RESERVED
156:                 and not record.owner._revoked, "exact_suspended_resume_owner")
157:         self._resume_attempted = True
158:         self.primitives._resume_after_future_admission(worker)
159:         return True

161:     def finish_start(self, worker, permit, profile):
162:         record = self._record(self.read_set, permit)
163:         _assert(worker is self.worker and permit is self.permit and profile is self.profile
164:                 and worker.resumed and record.phase is Phase.NATIVE_RESERVED
165:                 and not record.owner._revoked and self.adoption_response is None,
166:                 "exact_postresume_start_owner")
167:         try:
168:             self.pipes.write_bytes(self.pair, encode_private_bootstrap(self.channel.binding, self.master_key), _remaining(self.pipes.clock))
169:             self.pipes.write_bytes(self.pair, self.handshake.challenge(), _remaining(self.pipes.clock))
170:             self.handshake.accept_ready(self.pipes.read_frame(self.pair, _remaining(self.pipes.clock)))
171:             self.handshake._owned_phase(True)
172:             self.pipes.write_bytes(self.pair, self.channel.encode("adopt_readset", self.adoption_payload), _remaining(self.pipes.clock))
173:             operation, response = self.channel.decode(self.pipes.read_frame(self.pair, _remaining(self.pipes.clock)))
174:             self.handshake._owned_phase(True)
175:             expected_operation = "readset_ready" if self.case == "positive" else "readset_rejected"
176:             _assert(operation == expected_operation and response == expected_adoption_response(self.case), "fixed_adoption_response")
177:             self.adoption_response = response
178:             return True
179:         except BaseException:
180:             self.pipes._quarantine(self.pair)
181:             raise

183:     def stop_start_failure(self, worker):
184:         _assert(worker is self.worker and any(item is worker for item in self.primitives.workers)
185:                 and self.pair is not None and self.pair.worker is worker and self.pair.role == "controller",
186:                 "exact_retained_start_failure_owner")
187:         # This is terminal observation only, never logical cleanup or guard
188:         # retirement. The pipe port retains uncertainty and pending buffers.
189:         if self.channel is not None:
190:             self.channel.revoke()
191:         self.pipes._quarantine(self.pair)
192:         _assert(self.pair.forced_stop_attempted and self.pair.forced_process_stop_observed is True,
193:                 "start_failure_process_exit_unconfirmed")
194:         api = self.primitives.api
195:         exit_code = api.ffi.c_uint32()
196:         api.checked("GetExitCodeProcess", self.primitives._owned(worker.process), api.ffi.byref(exit_code))
197:         accounting, returned = api.structure("JOBOBJECT_BASIC_ACCOUNTING_INFORMATION"), api.ffi.c_uint32()
198:         api.checked("QueryInformationJobObject", self.primitives._owned(worker.job), JOB_BASIC_ACCOUNTING_CLASS,
199:                     api.ffi.byref(accounting), api.ffi.sizeof(accounting), api.ffi.byref(returned))
200:         _assert(exit_code.value != 259 and returned.value == api.ffi.sizeof(accounting)
201:                 and accounting.active_processes == 0, "start_failure_job_exit_unconfirmed")
202:         return not self.pair.operations

204:     def probe_generated(self, worker, permit):
205:         record = self._record(self.read_set, permit)
206:         _assert(worker is self.worker and record.phase is Phase.NATIVE_RUNNING
207:                 and self.adoption_response == expected_adoption_response(self.case), "adoption_before_probe")
208:         self.handshake._owned_phase(False)
209:         if self.case == "positive":
210:             self.pipes.write_bytes(self.pair, self.handshake.begin(), _remaining(self.pipes.clock))
211:             self.pipes.write_bytes(self.pair, self.channel.encode("next", {"read_generated_namespace": True}), _remaining(self.pipes.clock))
212:             operation, result = self.channel.decode(self.pipes.read_frame(self.pair, _remaining(self.pipes.clock)))
213:             _assert(operation == "done" and result == expected_readback(), "complete_child_generated_readback")
214:         else:
215:             # Expected refusal does not call begin, seek, materialize or a model.
216:             _assert(not self.handshake._begun, "refused_adoption_cannot_begin")
217:             result = {"expected_identity_refusal": True, "materialization_started": False}
218:         self.handshake._owned_phase(False)
219:         _assert(self.primitives.api.call("WaitForSingleObject", self.primitives._owned(worker.process), 0) == WAIT_TIMEOUT,
220:                 "child_not_alive_before_cancel")
221:         _assert(len(self.read_set.members) == 5 and all(not handle.closed for handle in self.read_set.members)
222:                 and all(handle.closed for handle in worker.inherited_copies), "parent_guards_must_remain_held")
223:         for path, expected in self.expectations:
224:             self.observations.append(_write_access_probe(self.primitives, path, True))
225:         return result

227:     def close_and_join(self, worker, permit):
228:         record = self._record(self.read_set, permit)
229:         _assert(worker is self.worker and record.phase is Phase.NATIVE_RUNNING, "dummy_close_owner")
230:         self.pipes.write_bytes(self.pair, self.channel.encode("cancel", {}), _remaining(self.pipes.clock))
231:         operation, payload = self.channel.decode(self.pipes.read_frame(self.pair, _remaining(self.pipes.clock)))
232:         _assert(operation == "closed" and payload == {}, "dummy_close_response")
233:         _assert(all(not handle.closed for handle in self.read_set.members), "parent_guards_before_exit")
234:         self.exit_observation = _observe_graceful_exit(self.primitives, worker, self.expected_exit)
235:         self.parent_guards_held_through_exit = all(not handle.closed for handle in self.read_set.members)
236:         _assert(self.parent_guards_held_through_exit, "parent_guard_lifetime")
237:         self.channel.revoke()
238:         return True

240:     def confirm_quiescent(self, protection, worker, permit):
241:         self._record(protection, permit)
242:         _assert(protection is self.read_set and worker is self.worker and worker.read_set is protection,
243:                 "dummy_quiescence_owner")
244:         # This exact record was created only by the immediately preceding
245:         # retained-process wait/GetExitCode/empty-job queries, not a wire value.
246:         return (self.exit_observation == {"child_native_exit": self.expected_exit, "process_wait_observed": True, "job_active_processes": 0}
247:                 and worker.quiescent and not worker.unconfirmed and not self.pair.operations)

249:     def release_read(self, protection):
250:         _assert(protection is self.read_set and self.worker is not None and self.worker.quiescent,
251:                 "dummy_release_requires_observed_native_exit")
252:         self.pipes.retire_endpoint(self.pair)
253:         self.primitives.close_quiescent_worker_handles(self.worker)
254:         return self.primitives.release_read_set(protection)

256:     def quarantine(self, key, protection, permit, reason):
257:         if protection is not None:
258:             protection.unconfirmed = True
259:         if self.channel is not None:
260:             self.channel.revoke()
261:         if self.pair is not None:
262:             self.pipes._quarantine(self.pair)
263:         # Local ownership/forced-stop attempt only. There is no durable recovery
264:         # port here, so never report durable quarantine as successfully persisted.
265:         return False
